newsitem.title: ITALY: Eight arrested in alleged Mafia plot to kill judge.
newsitem.headline: Eight arrested in alleged Mafia plot to kill judge.

text.p: Police said on Tuesday they had arrested eight alleged Mafiosi on suspicion that they plotted to kill one of Italy's leading anti-Mafia prosecutors.

Police said wiretapped telephone conversations revealed that the Mafia had approached a driver who worked for the public prosecutor's office in Palermo and asked him to plant a bomb in the armoured car of chief prosecutor Giancarlo Caselli.
The plot, which dated back to 1995, was not carried out.
Two prominent anti-Mafia prosecutors, Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino, were killed in separate bomb attacks in the Sicilian capital Palermo in 1992.
